display.purpose: Largest single statement on the page; reserved, not yet used at full scale.

headline.purpose: Hero name, navbar wordmark, top section emphasis.

title.purpose: Section sub-heads, card titles, role/project names.

label.purpose: Eyebrow captions and the smallest UI text (e.g. 'READING RIGHT NOW').

shadows.name: resting-glow
shadows.purpose: Default always-on glow on floating skill icons and similar ambient accents.

shadows.name: hover-glow
shadows.purpose: Amplified two-layer glow on hover/active state.

shadows.name: dual-pole-glow
shadows.purpose: Hero/about portrait ring — lit from two colored sources at once.

shadows.name: chrome-shadow
shadows.purpose: Mobile nav menu panel and scrim only — the deliberate neutral exception, used to recede rather than signal.

motion.name: reveal-cascade
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered entrance for every section/card, staggered ~80-160ms per sibling.

motion.name: hero-entrance
motion.purpose: Hero's one-time load-in: photo scale-in, then name/title/tags rise-in staggered.

motion.name: idle-float
motion.purpose: Floating skill icon perpetual idle motion; freezes and lifts to 1.1x on hover.

motion.name: ambient-background
motion.value: gradient wash 10s loop, particles 20s loop, smoke wisps 18s loop with burst-then-settle easing
motion.purpose: Persistent three-layer animated background; always running, honors reduced-motion.

motion.name: nav-dock-transition
motion.purpose: Navbar's animated move from top-of-page to bottom-pinned pill on scroll.

narrative.overview:
This is a dev-tool's confidence rendered as a portfolio, not a design agency's restraint. The palette is a two-color signal (Neon Magenta and Neon Cyan) burning against a near-black violet void — the same instinct as a terminal prompt or a status LED, not a corporate brand system. Nothing sits inert: a three-layer animated background (drifting gradient, floating dust, crossing smoke) keeps the whole page breathing even when the visitor isn't touching anything, and every interactive surface answers a hover or tap with a brighter, wider glow rather than a static color change.

The system rejects the generic "clean minimalist portfolio" reference entirely — flat white cards, muted pastels, and gentle drop-shadows have no place here. Depth is never gray; it's colored light. Density stays generous (wide padding, roomy type scale) so the neon reads as confident, not cluttered.
keyCharacteristics: Two-color neon signal (magenta + cyan) on near-black violet, never neutral gray or black surfaces
Glow is the only depth cue — no plain black box-shadows anywhere in the system
Persistent animated ambient background (gradient wash, particles, smoke) — always running, respects reduced-motion
Scroll-triggered reveal cascade on every section; idle float/rotate/pulse loops on hero and skill icons
Generous whitespace and a bold, confident type scale (Inter, weights 300–900)

rules.name: The No Neutral Rule
rules.body: No surface, border, or text color in this system is true gray or true black. Backgrounds and text neutrals are all violet-tinted; shadows and glows are always magenta or cyan, never Colors.black alone (the one exception — the mobile nav menu's drop shadow and scrim — stays black specifically because it needs to read as "recede," not "signal").

rules.name: The Triad Rule
rules.body: Any place the system needs to color something dynamically (per-technology chips, generative project fingerprints) draws from the same three stops — Magenta → Cyan → Soft Pink → Magenta — via deterministic hash, never an arbitrary or expanding palette.

rules.name: The Weight-Carries-Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Don't introduce a second typeface for emphasis — every hierarchy shift in this system is size + weight + tracking on Inter alone.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: There is no "flat vs. lifted" surface language independent of color. Depth is glow: every BoxShadow is tinted magenta or cyan, and its presence or intensity is a state signal, not a static resting elevation. Never flatten a glow to a plain black shadow.

rules.name: The Amplify-On-Interaction Rule
rules.body: Hover/active states never introduce a new visual language — they turn the same glow up (wider blur, more spread, sometimes a second shadow layer), never swap in a different effect.

dos: Do keep the animated background (gradient wash, particles, smoke) running everywhere — it's core identity, not optional chrome — while always respecting reduced-motion.
Do tint every shadow and glow magenta or cyan (or both, as a dual-pole glow); depth is color, never gray.
Do amplify existing glow on hover/focus rather than introducing a new effect.
Do stagger multi-item reveals and idle loops so groups never move as one rigid block.
Do derive any dynamically-colored element from the Magenta → Cyan → Soft-Pink triad via deterministic hash.
donts: Don't introduce a light theme or a light-mode surface — #07060B is the only background this system has.
Don't add a fourth brand hue outside the magenta/cyan/soft-pink triad.
Don't flatten a glow into a plain neutral box-shadow/black elevation.
Don't use pure black or pure gray for text, borders, or surfaces.
Don't add a second display typeface.
